name: Thunderhead Mountain
generated_description:
At 6,532 feet, Thunderhead Mountain is a summit in South Dakota. The Thunderhead Mountain Trail covers 1.8 miles with about 663 feet of elevation gain — a steady climb. It's rated Easy overall.

The Route

Most of the climbing comes early — the first half of the route does the bulk of the work before the grade eases. The steepest stretch arrives around mile 0.25, gaining roughly 800 feet per mile — expect a slow, deliberate pace through here.

Getting There

The trailhead is at 43.84734, -103.5663 (tap for driving directions). It's roughly 25 miles southwest of Rapid City, South Dakota. Arrive early on weekends — trailhead lots at popular peaks fill quickly, and cell service is often unreliable once you leave the highway.

When to Go

Late May through October is the main season. Snow and ice linger into spring and return early in fall at this latitude and elevation; in winter this becomes a different, more serious undertaking requiring traction devices and warm layers.

Know Before You Go

The Easy rating comes from the National Park Service difficulty formula, which weighs total distance against elevation gain. Most hikers should budget about 1.0 hours of moving time; add margin for breaks, photos and the descent. Download the GPX track from this page before you go — cell coverage is unreliable in the mountains and a saved route works offline in any GPS app. Conditions change: verify current access, closures and weather with the official land manager before you go. Trail data is sourced from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

Looking to link objectives or plan a weekend? Nearby summits include Little Devil's Tower, Black Elk Peak and Bear Mountain — each has its own guide on this site.

faqs.answer: The trailhead is at 43.84734, -103.5663 in South Dakota. Use the driving-directions link in the Getting There section above, and note that parking at popular trailheads fills early on weekends.

faqs.question: Are dogs allowed on the Thunderhead Mountain trail?
faqs.answer: Rules vary by land manager — national parks often prohibit dogs on trails, while most national forests allow them on leash. Check with the managing agency for this trail before bringing your dog, and pack out waste.

faqs.question: When is the best time to hike Thunderhead Mountain?
faqs.answer: Late May through October for snow-free hiking. Check a summit point forecast before you go — conditions up high differ from the trailhead.

faqs.question: How tall is Thunderhead Mountain?
faqs.answer: Thunderhead Mountain stands at 6,532 feet (1,991 meters) in South Dakota.
